Bounded Rage Wars ROM payloads and published C contract excerpts.
All five holding versions are retained; target digests pin each excerpt.
The 67F98 source owns five 0x58-byte wrappers; 00538 occupies the tail
of the 00500 source unit. Layout excerpts retain the published gap arrays
and Triple integer fields: no floating or aggregate identity is invented.
US revision 1 target offsets: A4E0=0x3B0D0 (2832 bytes),
66810=0x67430 (2432 bytes), 01A74=0x2674 (88 bytes).
The complete 96930 plane-intersection callee proves all four coefficients
through the exact +0x310 pointer forwarded by A4E0.
